project.name: npc_engine
project.overview:
NPC Engine is a FastAPI backend that manages a Neo4j knowledge graph of Characters, Events, and Locations, and exposes three runtime engines: 1. Dialogue Engine — LLM-powered, WebSocket-streamed, player-facing 2. Gossip Engine — deterministic, personality-weighted NPC-to-NPC knowledge propagation 3. Event Engine — world event generation and awareness seeding
Game clients (Unity / Unreal) connect via REST (state queries, tick control) and WebSocket (streaming dialogue). All writes are atomic via Neo4j transactions. All LLM interaction is abstracted behind a protocol; backends are swappable.
